searchText: `withdrawal-mainnet-shadowfork-2` is now live! Its currently still in bellatrix, we'll pick a transition epoch for shapella once the sepolia releases are out + some relays have had a chance to setup on there - we'll mainly use it for scenario testing. tooling link: https://ethstats.withdrawal-mainnet-shadowfork-2.ethpandaops.io/ We're still a bit light on tooling, it should be up soon. In the meantime, configs can be found here: https://github.com/ethpandaops/withdrawals-testnet/tree/master/withdrawal-mainnet-shadowfork-2/custom_config_data why is average block time 14.43s? ethstats doesnt take into account the time I stall the chain in order to create the shadowfork, so the stat on block time gets messed up. I've to sync to head -> stall chain -> take state and create genesis with block as exec_payload -> start shadowfork : and this process pads a decent bit of time to account for mistakes, etc. okay, but this means that now that the network is running at a consistent 12s/slot (presumably) it will converge to that Yup, it should 😄 its a regular beaconchain, so 12s slots

`withdrawal-mainnet-shadowfork-2` is now live! Its currently still in bellatrix, we'll pick a transition epoch for shapella once the sepolia releases are out + some relays have had a chance to setup on there - we'll mainly use it for scenario testing. 

tooling link: https://ethstats.withdrawal-mainnet-shadowfork-2.ethpandaops.io/

We're still a bit light on tooling, it should be up soon. In the meantime, configs can be found here:
https://github.com/ethpandaops/withdrawals-testnet/tree/master/withdrawal-mainnet-shadowfork-2/custom_config_data

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
ethstats doesnt take into account the time I stall the chain in order to create the shadowfork, so the stat on block time gets messed up.

I've to sync to head -> stall chain -> take state and create genesis with block as exec_payload -> start shadowfork : and this process pads a decent bit of time to account for mistakes, etc.

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: okay, but this means that now that the network is running at a consistent 12s/slot (presumably) it will converge to that

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
Yup, it should 😄

its a regular beaconchain, so 12s slots
